name: Violent Crime (Homicide Rate)
description: Intentional homicides per 100,000 population. The empirical gold standard for violent crime comparison.

name: Global Peace Index
description: Measures ongoing domestic and international armed conflicts, level of militarisation, and societal safety.

name: Terrorism Impact (GTI)
description: Direct casualties, physical damage, and ongoing attacks from extremist violence.

name: Road Safety (Traffic Deaths)
description: Annual road traffic fatality rate. In peacetime nations, daily transit fatality risk dwarfs violent crime.

name: Natural Disaster & Hazard Safety
source: Bündnis Entwicklung Hilft & Ruhr University Bochum
description: Exposure to earthquakes, cyclones, floods, and droughts weighted against national infrastructure coping capacity.

name: Organised Crime Resilience
source: Global Initiative Against Transnational Organised Crime (GI-TOC)
description: Penalises high cartel, mafia, and illicit contraband operations while crediting state judicial enforcement resilience.

name: Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI)
description: Perceived public sector graft, administrative bribery risks, and accountability of state officials.

name: Rule of Law Indicator
description: Confidence in judicial contracts, property rights enforcement, police fairness, and courts.

name: Government Effectiveness
description: Quality of public services, civil service independence from political pressures, and policy delivery.

name: Property & Land Rights Security
description: Legal protection of physical land tenure, protection from unlawful expropriation, and intellectual property rights.

name: GDP per Capita (PPP)
description: Gross domestic product per person adjusted for purchasing power parity.

name: Local Purchasing Power
description: How far local earnings stretch against domestic prices for everyday goods, groceries, and housing.

name: Economic Complexity Index (ECI)
description: Mathematical measure of knowledge diversity and technical sophistication in national export trade.

name: Income Equality (Low Gini / CRI)
description: Equitable distribution of national income and social welfare investment. Low Gini coefficient indicates broad wealth sharing.

name: Workers' Rights & Union Protections
description: Evaluates collective bargaining rights, strike protections, fair dismissals, and physical safety of trade union members.

name: Work-Life Balance & Reasonable Hours
description: Share of employees working reasonable hours (avoiding 50+ hrs/wk burnouts), statutory annual leave, and personal leisure time.

name: Housing Affordability (Price-to-Income)
description: Median home price and rent as a multiple of median disposable household income. Lower multiples mean shelter is affordable.

name: Healthy Life Expectancy (HALE)
description: Expected years lived in full health, stripping out years burdened with severe disease and physical disability.

name: Universal Health Coverage (UHC Index)
description: Effective coverage of essential health services (prevention, infectious disease management, and emergency care).

name: Child Welfare & Family Rights
description: Protection of children's rights across health, education, protection, enabling environment, and parental statutory leave.

name: Education & Academic Attainment
description: Mean years of adult schooling and expected years of schooling for youth, tracking cognitive capital and literacy.

name: World Press Freedom Index
description: Independence of journalists, safety from state surveillance, legal protections, and media pluralism.

name: V-Dem Liberal Democracy Index
description: Protection of minority rights, individual liberties, judicial review checks, and electoral transparency.

name: Religious Freedom & Toleration
description: Freedom of worship, belief, conversion, and practice free from state restrictions (Pew GRI), blasphemy laws, and sectarian societal violence (Pew SHI).

name: LGBTQ+ Equality & Legal Protections
description: Non-discrimination laws, marriage equality, legal recognition, hate crime penalties, and freedom from persecution.

name: Women, Peace and Security Index (WPS)
source: Georgetown Institute for Women, Peace and Security
description: Evaluates women's inclusion (education, employment), justice (legal equality), and security (freedom from gender violence).

name: Academic Freedom Index (AFI)
description: Freedom to research, teach, and publish, institutional autonomy of universities, and absence of campus ideological censorship.

name: Median Broadband Download Speed
description: Real-world measured fixed and mobile download speed experienced by everyday internet users.

name: Trade & Logistics Infrastructure (LPI)
description: Quality and efficiency of ports, freight rail, roads, customs clearance, and commercial distribution.

name: Internet User Penetration
description: Share of individuals regularly utilising internet services for daily civic and economic activities.

name: Public Transit Access & Walkability
description: Share of the urban population with convenient walking access (within 500m) to reliable public transit and rail networks.

name: Bioclimatic Quality & Comfort (Holiday Climate Index - HCI)
description: Holiday Climate Index evaluating thermal comfort via Humidex, rainy day frequency, annual sunshine hours, and extreme heat (>30°C) / freezing thresholds.

name: Clean Air (Low Ambient PM2.5)
description: Annual average ambient exposure to fine particulate matter PM2.5. Lower concentrations equal cleaner air.

name: Clean Water & Sanitation Access
description: Population share with reliable access to safely managed drinking water and hygienic municipal sanitation.

name: Climate Change Resilience & Adaptation
description: A country's vulnerability to climate disruptions compared with its civil, economic, and institutional readiness to adapt.
